data.name: Nileshkumar
data.gender_notes: Nileshkumar is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Nileshkumar is a Sanskrit name composed of two words: Nilesh and Kumar. Nilesh means 'Lord of the Gods', and Kumar refers to 'younger brother of God Shiva'. Thus, Nileshkumar represents the divine brother of the God of Destruction. The name Nileshkumar carries the meaning “Lord of the Gods” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Nileshkumar usually hope their child will grow to embody lord of the gods and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Embodying the divine power of Lord Shiva, Nileshkumar is a name that inspires devotion and spiritual growth.
data.etymology: Nileshkumar belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lord of the Gods.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nileshkumar total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
